description: This file defines a function oauth_get_token that handles OAuth authentication with Azure AD, including token retrieval, user profile fetching, and basic validation logic. It interacts with external endpoints via cURL and processes JSON Web Tokens.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Standard PHP class used for creating generic objects to hold various data like authentication results and options.

methods.name: oauth_get_token
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuth access token from Azure AD, fetches user profile info, validates the email domain if configured, and returns a result object indicating success or failure.
